title: rosa × odorata var. pseudindica
intro: Rosa × odorata var. pseudindica, commonly known as the Himalayan rose or Tibetan rose, is a variety of fragrant rose that is native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × odorata var. pseudindica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. These bioactive constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
